plan.scene: A sunny rooftop terrace in the late afternoon: wooden deck, potted olive trees, string lights and a soft-focus city skyline under a blue sky.

shots.what: one continuous arm's-length front-camera phone selfie, chest-up: she holds the tumbler by its blue handle beside her face and talks to the camera, tips the lid toward the camera, keeps talking, takes a sip through the straw and lowers the cup beside her face with a smile

subjects.role: the woman filming the selfie and talking to the camera
subjects.traits: a Latina woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a plain terracotta-orange crew-neck t-shirt

subjects.role: the tumbler she holds by its handle
subjects.traits: a butter-yellow tapered insulated tumbler with a large powder-blue side handle, a clear round lid with a powder-blue rim, a yellow straw with a blue base, and a powder-blue tethered cap with a small pale-yellow star charm

constraints: Exactly the same head, arm, hand and cup movements with the same timing as the source; she holds the tumbler by its handle in the same one hand the whole time and never uses a second hand.
The tumbler keeps the exact butter-yellow and powder-blue colours and shape of the reference.
No text, captions, logos or watermarks.
Authentic phone-selfie look with natural daylight.
